records.rationale: The complete GPO printing at PDF89/printed76, signed Theodore Roosevelt and dated September 20, 1906, permits the specified quarterly session on November 15 instead of October 1, 1906. It contains no November 16 administrative day, no wind-down allowance, and no November 17 own-term expiration. The candidate's positive assertions that permission remained available during an administrative wind-down and included one administrative day for closing business have no supplied factual or legal source. Its claimed equivalence between November 17 as first inoperative civil date and close of November 15 is also calendrically false: the next civil date is November 16. That observation does not approve a replacement whole-case claim. The complete parent EO317A, PDF46-49/printed33-36, permits a session to continue as long as public business requires; it supplies neither a fixed adjournment nor a one-day wind-down. EO506 contains one scheduling substitution and no separate appointment, reporting, or recurring rule, but meeting performance, duration and adjournment cannot be inferred. The candidate must distinguish expiry of fresh authority to commence on a specified day from continuation and consequences of a session properly convened. A bounded local quarterly search additionally located the separate November 17, 1906 reorganization (EO527, PDF93-95/printed80-82), which changes the parent schedule and preserves nonconflicting Canal orders. That source does not establish the candidate's alleged own-term wind-down or show that the special November 15 session ceased November 17. No genuine counterpart or control classification was inspected.
records.identity_check: Allowed date/subject crosswalk maps entry44 to EO506, September 20, 1906, next quarterly session November 15 instead of October 1 (WPA M54). Complete body, Roosevelt signature and date agree visually; the compilation prints no EO number. Parent crosswalk maps April 1, 1905 reorganization to EO317A.
records.earlier_candidates: September 20 is issuance; October 1 is the displaced session date; November 15 is the permitted date. Close of November 15/November 16 may describe the boundary of fresh date-specific scheduling authority, not proven adjournment or a complete lifecycle. November 17 reorganization is a separate actor and mechanism, not an own-term administrative day.
records.savings_residuals: No express savings or independent continuing command in EO506 itself. Parent-authorized session continuation and validity of actions already taken require separation from the date-specific substitution. Parent's other appointments, departments, contracts and reporting duties are not EO506 commands. Neither those duties nor historical consequences justify inventing wind-down performance.
